settings.name: Alpha Arbutin 2%
settings.function: Blocks enzymatic synthesis of melanin pigment. Specifically chosen at maximum safe concentration of 2.0% for hyperpigmentation correction in Fitzpatrick IV-VI skin profiles.

settings.name: Triple Ceramide Complex
settings.function: Bio-identical lipid matrix mimicking skin's natural structure. Interlocking matrix that seals transepidermal water loss and restores compromised skin barriers.
settings.study_ref: Int. Journal of Molecular Sci. Vol 22

settings.name: 6-Filter UV System
settings.function: Broad spectrum hybrid physical/organic sunscreen network. Specifically optimized for stable protection in extreme temperature climates and sebum-resistant matte finish.

settings.name: Niacinamide 5%
settings.function: Clinical amide compound that suppresses pigment transfer from melanocytes to outer skin cells. Regulates sebum production to control acne flare-ups in humid summers.

settings.name: Tranexamic Acid 2%
settings.function: Blocks the inflammatory triggers that activate melanocytes. Works synergistically with Alpha Arbutin to dual-target stubborn post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH).

settings.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
settings.function: Low molecular weight hydration complex that penetrates beyond the skin surface. Hydrates skin deeper, preparing the barrier for highly effective active ingredient absorption.
settings.study_ref: J. of Drugs in Dermatol. Vol 13

settings.name: Panthenol
settings.function: Pro-vitamin humectant with film-forming properties. Locks moisture into the outer skin layers and accelerates tissue healing under irritation stress.
settings.study_ref: American J. of Clin. Derm. Vol 3

settings.name: Zinc PCA
settings.function: Sebum-regulating zinc salt that reduces excess sebum secretion. Essential for keeping sunscreen and moisturizers fully matte in high humidity climates.
settings.study_ref: Int. Journal of Cosmetic Sci. Vol 25

settings.name: Licorice Root Extract
settings.function: Botanical brightening agent containing Glabridin. Calms the baseline inflammation that triggers melanin overproduction and subsequent dark spot formations.

settings.name: Allantoin
settings.function: Comfrey-derived cell proliferation agent that speeds outer barrier recovery. Softens skin texture and acts as an anti-irritant buffer for high-potency actives.

settings.name: Tocopherol
settings.function: Lipophilic antioxidant that shields skin lipids from oxidative stress. Prevents environmental and UV-induced degradation of the skin's protective barrier.

settings.name: Matrixyl 3000
settings.function: Signal peptide complex that stimulates dermal collagen and elastin synthesis. Works alongside surface lipids to reinforce skin's structural scaffolding.
